narrative.name: NERC CIP power grid
narrative.splunkValue: We evidence BES Cyber System categorisation, monitor Electronic Security Perimeter traffic for unapproved protocols, log privileged-access sessions to EMS / SCADA, and prepare the CIP-008 incident response artefacts a regional audit team expects to see.
narrative.whatItIs: The mandatory cybersecurity standard for North America's bulk electric system. NERC CIP requires grid operators to identify critical cyber assets, wall them off behind Electronic Security Perimeters, and prove compliance to regional entities such as WECC, RFC, and SERC.
narrative.whoItAffects: Registered entities on the North American bulk electric system — generation operators, transmission owners, balancing authorities, reliability coordinators, and their contractors — in the US, Canada, and parts of Mexico.
